#30DayChartChallenge Day 29 — Monochrome (Uncertainties category)
huggingface : https://huggingface.co/datasets/afmck/peanuts-opt-6.7b
nicola rennie's article on monochrome: https://nrennie.rbind.io/blog/monochrome-data-visualisations/


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages("arrow")
library(arrow)
library(gganimate)
```

```{r}
# try files 0000 through 0020
file_nums <- sprintf("%04d", 0:20)
files <- paste0(
  "https://huggingface.co/datasets/afmck/peanuts-opt-6.7b/resolve/refs%2Fconvert%2Fparquet/default/train/",
  file_nums, ".parquet"
)

df_all <- bind_rows(lapply(files, function(f) {
  tryCatch(
    read_parquet(f) |> select(-image),  # drop image column
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}))

range(df_all$year)
nrow(df_all)
```


```{r}
# unnest the characters list column
char_counts <- df_all |>
  select(year, characters) |>
  unnest(characters) |>
  rename(character = characters) |>
  count(year, character) |>
  mutate(character = case_when(
    character %in% c("Joe Cool", "the World War I Flying Ace") ~ "Snoopy",
    character == "\"Pig-Pen\"" ~ "Pig-Pen",
    TRUE ~ character
  ))

# top characters overall
char_counts |>
  group_by(character) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n)) |>
  arrange(desc(total))

char_counts |>
  group_by(character) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  print(n = 19)

```

```{r}
# re-do from char_counts with Snoopy consolidation
char_counts_clean <- char_counts |>
  group_by(year, character) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# top 12 by total appearances
top_chars <- char_counts_clean |>
  group_by(character) |>
  summarise(total = sum(n)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(character)

# verify
top_chars
```

```{r}
heatmap_data <- char_counts_clean |>
  filter(character %in% top_chars) |>
  mutate(character = factor(character, levels = rev(top_chars)))

p <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = year, y = character, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black",
                      name = "# of Appearances") +
  labs(
    title = "50 Years of Peanuts",
    subtitle = "Top 10 character appearances by year, 1950–2000",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Data: Peanuts comic strips (afmck/peanuts-opt-6.7b)\n#30DayChartChallenge | Created by: Lyndsay Miles"
  ) +
  ggthemes::theme_economist_white(base_size = 14)+
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 10)),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
p
ggsave("img/cc_2026_day29.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
Animated version
```{r}

p_anim <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = year, y = character, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black",
                      name = "# of Appearances") +
  labs(
    title = "50 Years of Peanuts",
    subtitle = "Top 10 character appearances by year, 1950–2000",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Data: Peanuts comic strips (afmck/peanuts-opt-6.7b)\n#30DayChartChallenge | Created by: Lyndsay Miles"
  ) +
  ggthemes::theme_economist_white(base_size = 14)+
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 10)),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )+
  transition_time(year) +
  shadow_mark() +  # keeps previous years visible
  ggthemes::theme_fivethirtyeight() +
  theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.ticks = element_blank()
)

animate(p_anim, fps = 8, duration = 12, 
        width = 800, height = 500,
        renderer = gifski_renderer("img/cc_2026_day29.gif"))
```
